title: Sanity Checking Causal Representation Learning on a Simple Real-World System
abstract: arXiv:2502.20099v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We evaluate methods for causal representation learning (CRL) on a simple, real-world system that satisfies the basic problem setup of CRL. The system consists of a controlled optical experiment producing a variety of measurements where the underlying causal factors---the control inputs to the experiment---are known, providing a ground truth. We select methods representative of different approaches to CRL and find that they all fail to consistently recover the underlying causal factors. To understand the failure modes of the evaluated algorithms, we perform an ablation on the data by substituting the real data-generating process with a simpler synthetic equivalent. The results reveal a reproducibility problem, as most methods already fail on this synthetic ablation despite its simple data-generating process. translated_title: 在简单真实世界系统上对因果表征学习进行合理性检验
translated_abstract: 我们在一个满足因果表征学习（CRL）基本问题设定的简单真实世界系统上评估了各种因果表征学习方法。该系统由一个受控光学实验组成，可产生多种测量结果，其中潜在的因果因素——即实验的控制输入——是已知的，从而提供了真值基准。我们选取了代表不同CRL技术路线的代表性方法，发现它们都无法一致地恢复潜在的因果因素。为了理解这些被评估算法的失败模式，我们通过用更简单的合成等效数据生成过程替代真实数据，对数据进行了消融实验。结果揭示了一个可复现性问题：尽管该合成消融实验的数据生成过程非常简单，但大多数方法在此实验中已然失败。此外，我们观察到关于混合函数的常见假设对某些方法的性能至关重要。
tldr: 该论文在一个具有已知因果因素真值的受控光学实验系统上评估了多种因果表征学习方法，发现现有方法均无法可靠地恢复潜在因果因素，并通过消融实验揭示了该领域存在的可复现性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates causal representation learning methods on a controlled optical experiment with known ground-truth causal factors, finding that existing methods fail to consistently recover the underlying causal factors and revealing reproducibility issues in the field.
